test(sh-strength r3): B through the product settings, B with crop and a quarter turn, redraws without a change

- SharpenPathPolicyTest: restartRenderer releases first, starts the next only after it let go; nothing without a renderer.
- fixture strength_ab 30/30: + cropB133_s35 (64x48 buffer, 64x40 visible, magenta padding: max |d| 2.2, no padding)
  and rot90B133_s35 (53x85, max 0.6) against the shader model; the placement now carries its view.
- AVD method_ui 16/16 (seam-free APK, the normal settings UI): fresh = A; a real tap on 화면 크기 (실험) -> B drawn by
  the setting (display pass mode=1 method=display), same placement, text edge 10.97 -> 16.31; B -> 끄기 -> direct,
  picture in place; 끄기 -> 강하게 -> B again (a new renderer); 기본 -> A again (10.97); 화면 크기 kept across a
  restart and shown selected. compare_ab 26/26, touch_ab 36/36, latency_ab: glRedraws 0 for A and B over 60 s each
  (r2's B logged 18 in one 5 s window); window p95 medians off 85.1 / A.60 98.9 / B.60 110.6 ms, draw wall 12.1 / 21.4 ms
  (AVD SwiftShader -- not a phone's GPU).
